name: NVDA Tower
text: The tallest building in Base City, crowned with a giant chip. On every Payday it throws NVDA stock certificates over the streets.
withCashy: Cashy’s pool is paired with NVDAc, Coinbase’s tokenized Nvidia stock. 2.14% of every Cashy trade goes to holders, paid in NVDA.

name: Feel.cash Exchange
text: The trading floor of Base City, wrapped in a live ticker band, with twin towers for every stock and the coin paired with it. Where stocks meet internet culture.
withCashy: Cashy launches on Feel.cash, paired with NVDAc. Every Cashy trade runs through Feel.cash, and 2.14% of every Cashy trade goes to holders, paid in NVDA.

name: iPod Store
text: A giant white iPod rising from a dark stage. Apple is the company. IPOD is the culture.
withCashy: “Buy an iPod for cash”: a crossover between Cashy and IPOD, the Apple-paired coin on Feel.cash, with shared art and joint contests.

name: City Guide tower
text: The lookout over Base City. Open the guide for the list of places, the partners and how to get around.

name: Cashy
text: Base City’s own money. He walks the streets and hops across the rooftops. Cash in. NVDA out.

name: Chip Factory
text: A clean-room chip factory with a wafer for a sign. Home of the Base Printer: how Cashy works, Payday history and Print my receipt.

name: Cashy Arcade
text: A building shaped like an arcade cabinet. Cashy Tower and Printer Panic live here; the weekly top 3 win CASHY.

name: Bank
text: Holder ranks: banknote tiers based on how much and how long you hold.

name: Base Stadium
text: An oval bowl with tiered seats, a floodlit pitch and a big screen. The place for match days, watch parties and community events.

name: Pet Store
text: A small shop with a paw-print sign, a striped awning and a pet bed in the window. A future neighbour is getting ready to move in.

name: AI Data Centre
text: Racks of servers, spinning cooling fans and green status lights. This is where the chips from the Chip Factory go to work.

name: Monorail Station
text: An elevated platform on the monorail loop, reached by a glass lift. The train stops here on every lap.

name: Harbour Pier
text: A wooden pier at the head of the bay, with two small boats that bob on the water.

name: Open plot
text: A cultural Base project that joins gets a building here, designed around its own identity, and its characters move into the streets.

name: Base project
text: A Base community that moved in. Its characters walk the streets instead of the bots.

name: Base Park
text: A green square for community events, meetups and weekly calls.
